subject: Re: Suncrest pilot — request for non-standard credit + longer evaluation
body:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@suncrest.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suncrest pilot — trial length and credits question

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the retrieval/response latency looked promising for our internal use case. Procurement and our ML infra lead asked a few practical questions before we sign the SOW:

- Our review timeline is longer than usual (we need to run two integration tests and a security scan). Is it possible to extend the standard PLG evaluation window from 14 days to 45 days for this pilot?
- The default free credits for a PLG sandbox are limited; given the volume we’ll need to exercise (multi-shard indexing + 100k embedding calls), can Redwood provide a one-off credit uplift (~$12,000) to avoid early throttle?

We’re trying to avoid a formal PO until we validate the integration, so these two items are blockers for procurement. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Platform, Suncrest AI

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@suncrest.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suncrest pilot — trial length and credits question

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask.

Jordan: can you confirm whether this matches what we discussed in the demo and share any notes on expected token/embedding consumption over the 45-day window? Monica, can you confirm whether CS is ok with the scope (index size + ops) and whether我们 can provide test harness guidance to reduce run cost?

Internally, this would be outside our standard PLG guardrails: typical self-serve credit caps are $500 and 14-day windows. For a one-off uplift + 45-day window we’ll need exec signoff and a short note on risk/controls: what data flows, whether they need private deployment, and any compliance asks. I’ve attached the draft SOW and their filled questionnaire for context.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Suncrest_SOW_v1.pdf, Suncrest_Risk_Questionnaire.xlsx

---
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Suncrest pilot — proposed ask for deal desk / exec

Folks,

Summary of customer ask (Suncrest AI):
- Extend evaluation window: 45 days (vs standard 14).
- One-off free credits: $12,000 to cover embedding + indexing spikes during integration tests.
- No immediate PO; they want to validate integration first.

Why I recommend approving:
- This is a likely mid-market conversion (expected ARR $180k year 1), low legal complexity (no PHI), and they’ve committed engineering time.
- If we force them into an early PO it will delay by several weeks and increase churn risk.

Recommended approval (nonstandard):
- Approve a 45-day sandbox window and a $12k credit uplift, conditional on:
  1) Data classification remains non-sensitive (as stated in questionnaire).
  2) We create a mutual action plan with clear stop conditions and usage caps per day.

Requesting: Deal desk / exec confirmation and an owner for the MxA (I can draft).

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suncrest pilot — approval request (Laura)

Team — looping Aditya for exec signoff. Quick points:
- Risk questionnaire looks clean: no regulated data types.
- CS can provide a guarded test harness that limits per-minute ingest to avoid runaway consumption; Monica can lead.
- This is within our play for strategic mid-market pilots; main ask is that the uplift is constrained and we log the trial under a special trial code for finance tracking.

Aditya — can you confirm approval for the non-standard uplift? If positive, please reply with wording we can provide to procurement (I’ll add the finance tracking code and MxA draft).

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Sales Operations

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suncrest pilot — approval request (Aditya)

Approved with conditions.

Approval: one-time $12,000 credit uplift and a 45-day evaluation window for Suncrest AI (DEAL-8247).

Conditions to include in approval note to procurement:
1) Trial is limited to non-sensitive data only; any change to data classification requires immediate pause.
2) Credits expire at end of the 45-day window; unused credits are forfeited.
3) CS (Monica) to provide a daily usage cap and monitoring alert to Marcus/Jordan if consumption exceeds 110% of forecast for two consecutive days.
4) Legal to include a simple amendment/MxA (not a full contract) confirming the uplift and timeline; procurement must sign the DocuSign within 7 days of the trial start.
5) Finance to tag the uplift under temporary deal code: TRIAL-8247-ONEOFF for reconciliation.

Please send the note to Suncrest procurement with the above language. Laura — once procurement signs, coordinate the start date. Jordan/Marcus, please attach the MxA and HubSpot deal link in the send.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@suncrest.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Suncrest Procurement <procurement@suncrest.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Suncrest pilot — confirmation of temporary uplift and next steps

Emily — quick update and next steps: executive signoff received.

Approved items (summary for procurement):
- One-time credit uplift: $12,000 (code: TRIAL-8247-ONEOFF). Credits will be applied to the sandbox account upon trial activation.
- Evaluation window: 45 days from activation date. Unused credits expire at window end.

Conditions (as required by approval):
- Data classification: non-sensitive only per the attached questionnaire. Any reclassification pauses the trial immediately.
- Usage controls: CS will enforce a daily cap and monitor consumption; alerts to our team at 110% of forecast.
- DocuSign amendment: procurement must sign the lightweight MxA within 7 days of trial start; link below.

Action items:
- Jordan: please confirm a proposed trial start date (Monica will coordinate the test harness).
- Emily/procurement: please review and sign the DocuSign amendment: https://docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d
- Laura/Finance: please set the finance tag TRIAL-8247-ONEOFF after signature.

Happy to schedule a kickoff call for Wed if helpful.

Thanks all — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced above: Suncrest_SOW_v1.pdf, Suncrest_Risk_Questionnaire.xlsx
